references.observation: The sign identifies the miniature as the King David Hotel and gives display number 341.
The garden elevation shows thirteen rounded red awnings, two projecting end pavilions, a taller central band of glazing and the curved glass rotunda.
The oblique view shows the neighboring pools and the building wings at the top of the terraced garden.
The square-ended swimming pool and separate smaller basin sit below the planted terraces.
The tennis court is on its own raised platform and has a perimeter fence and net.
Side-on aerial footage places the hotel on a distinct low garden terrace beside the park path. The long roof, garden geometry and adjacent courts identify the exhibit.

references.credit: Google panorama, archived by Virtual Globetrotting contributor daggerwell
references.observation: The geolocated view shows the garden-facing façade obliquely from above. The pool lies to the left and the tennis court to the right. Projecting balconies form vertical stacks under the belt course.

map.note: The historical miniature clears the nominal PMTiles footway by 0.29 m. The dated lower terrace grade exposes the garden, pool and court and supports the front plinth. The stock paths retain their geometry and the largest sampled paving height change is about 2 cm. Terrain grids coarser than about 1 m may omit the local grade and partly cover the lower garden.

limitations: The model represents the display photographed in the 2003 archive, the panorama published in 2012 and the 2022 flyover. Present condition is unverified.
The façade height ratio is fitted to the archived camera. Absolute dimensions, rear openings, roof fixtures and terrace depths remain photographic estimates.

The garden-facing bearing and miniature scale come from the archived exhibit photographs and panorama. A one-metre east adjustment within the photographed planting island yields an approximate site fit over the retained PMTiles footways. The reconstruction appears on the snapshot date. The original platform coordinates and current display condition remain unresolved.

plantedIslandTrial.notes: The footprint and roof fit on the photographed planting island. The shifted camera is on the visible pavement, but the position is approximate. One stock PMTiles footway crosses the model at its nominal width. The route correction and lower garden grade pass in the isolated fixture and remain trial inputs.
